QUOTE: "`_DEFINITIVE`: "This IS a definitive empty result… Do not retry"" and "`_UNREAD_CORPUS`: "NOT DEFINITIVE… this index HOLDS matching rows that search does not read"" and "`_PROSE_ELSEWHERE`: "NOT DEFINITIVE… this repository DOES use these terms""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates definitive from not-definitive but never states a "definitive for a reason that is not absence" grade. Its verdicts are definitive-absence or not-definitive, so the third grade the item requires is missing.
